devices.description: 40 x 4 I2C LCD driver for static and 1:2, 1:3, 1:4 multiplex glass (PCF8576D, PCF85176, PCA85176H), 1.8-5.5 V logic
devices.note: pcf85176.pdf p.2 ordering (PCF85176H TQFP64 SOT357-1, PCF85176T TSSOP56 SOT364-1), p.4-5 pinning and Table 3, p.5-8 commands (Tables 4-10), p.9 power-on reset, p.19 clock, timing and backplane outputs, p.20-26 RAM, data pointer, subaddress, banks, p.28 I2C address, p.31-33 characteristics (VDD 1.8-5.5 V, fclk(int) 1850 Hz typ, ffr 77 Hz typ). pcf8576d.pdf (PCF8576DT TSSOP56, same pinout and logic): p.2 ordering, p.4-6 pinning, p.7 power-on reset, p.16 ffr = fclk / 24 and backplane pairing, p.17-24 RAM, Figure 13 fills, data pointer, subaddress, banks and commands, p.27 address, p.31-32 characteristics. pca85176.pdf (PCA85176H TQFP64 automotive): p.2 ordering, p.4 pinning, p.6-9 the same commands, p.9 power-on reset, p.32-33 fclk(int) PCA85176H 1850 Hz typ, ffr 77 Hz typ. Power-on: mode 1:4, E = 0 (display disabled, outputs at VLCD -> released here), pointer, counter, banks, blink cleared. The frame is the model's half period (Tfr / 2, Tfr = 24 / fclk, Figure 11 p.15: one pass of the backplanes per polarity). Modeled: I2C write address 0111 00 SA0 (0x38 / 0x39); command bytes with the C continuation bit (mode-set C 10 - E B M1 M0, load-data-pointer C 0 P5-P0, device-select, bank-select C 11110 I O, blink-select C 1110 AB BF1 BF0), the display data bytes after the last command byte, stored in the 40 x 4 RAM by mode (static 1 row, 1:2 2 rows, 1:3 3 rows, 1:4 4 rows per column, most significant bit first, data pointer step 8 / 4 / 3 / 2, the pointer wraps past column 39 and increments the subaddress counter, bits past column 39 fall into the next device), storing only while the subaddress counter equals the hardware subaddress pins, the input and output RAM banks in static and 1:2, the display-enable bit E (E = 0 releases every BP and S pin), the backplane slots (static all four BP pins alike, 1:2 BP0 = BP2 and BP1 = BP3, 1:3 BP3 = BP1, 1:4 one each) and the frame time. Not modeled: LCD bias and VLCD (bias and blink-select bits are only stored), blinking, the CLK / SYNC / OSC cascade and clock pins (the frame always runs from the internal oscillator), the missing acknowledge of a data byte addressed to another subaddress, the refusal of a read address byte.
